name: Joe Bird
bio: Joe Bird (born April 8th, 2007) is an Australian actor. He was born in Liverpool, but he is based in Adelaide. He is known for his role as Riley in Talk To Me (2023), and his leading role as Naim in Leviticus (2026).

credits.title: Crashout
credits.overview: Stranded on a remote stretch of highway after a fatal car accident, three fresh high school graduates desperately fabricate a found footage film, concealing their unintentional crime to salvage their futures.

credits.title: Despite the Night
credits.overview: Months after a distant volcanic eruption, a cloud of ash continues to loom over northern Australia. With the region plunged into an eternal night, its inhabitants flee south. Trapped inside an apartment, two brothers care for their ailing grandmother – one longing to flee, the other clinging to what remains.

credits.title: Leviticus
credits.overview: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most:  each other.

credits.title: Wolfram
credits.overview: 1930s Australia, the colonial frontier: two swaggering outlaws roll into a mining town and unleash a wave of cruelty, leading three kids to break free from their white masters and set off across the 'sweet country' of central Australia in search of a safe home.

credits.title: The Worm
credits.overview: A young man’s strange belief sparks an intervention from his family.

credits.title: In the Grip of Terror: Making Talk to Me
credits.overview: The cast and crew talk about making the film with some behind-the-scenes footage.

credits.title: Talk to Me
credits.overview: When a group of friends discover how to conjure spirits using an embalmed hand, they become hooked on the new thrill, until one of them goes too far and unleashes terrifying supernatural forces.

credits.title: Treasure
credits.overview: A nostalgic exploration of adolescence, through the escapades of two boys, Tim and Eddy.

credits.title: Rabbit
credits.overview: A year after her identical twin's disappearance, Maude Ashton is still haunted by visions of her sister's violent abduction. Convinced she is still alive, Maude follows the clues to a derelict caravan park.
